source_document.title: L. 297/1982, disciplina del trattamento di fine rapporto e norme in materia pensionistica

location.quote: Agli oneri derivanti al Fondo pensioni dei lavoratori dipendenti dall'applicazione del presente articolo si provvede elevando le aliquote contributive a carico dei datori di lavoro, per l'assicurazione generale obbligatoria per l'invalidità, la vecchiaia ed i superstiti dei lavoratori dipendenti, ivi compresi gli addetti ai servizi domestici e familiari ed i pescatori della piccola pesca, con decorrenza dal periodo di paga in corso alla data del 1 luglio 1982 nella misura dello 0,30 per cento della retribuzione imponibile e con decorrenza dal periodo di paga in corso alla data del 1 gennaio 1983 nella misura ulteriore dello 0,20 per cento della retribuzione imponibile. I datori di lavoro detraggono per ciascun lavoratore l'importo della contribuzione aggiuntiva di cui al comma precedente dall'ammontare della quota del trattamento di fine rapporto relativa al periodo di riferimento della contribuzione stessa. Qualora il trattamento di fine rapporto sia erogato mediante forme previdenziali, la contribuzione aggiuntiva è detratta dal contributo dovuto per il finanziamento del trattamento stesso, il cui importo spettante al lavoratore è corrispondentemente ridotto.

provenance.transformation: 0.30% from 1 July 1982 plus 0.20% from 1 January 1983 = 0.50% of the INPS taxable pay, applied to the IVS base of the period (capped at the massimale when it applies) and deducted from the TFR quota of the same period, or from the TFR paid to the pension fund.
provenance.note: Quote checked on 2026-10-07 against the Normattiva text of art. 3 in force from 10-11-2022 (commi counted in order; INPS messaggio n. 1817 of 10 May 2019, read from the copy at https://assolavoro.eu/wp-content/uploads/attachments/mess_1817%20pdf.pdf, cites the rate as c. 15 and the deduction as c. 16), whitespace normalised. The 0.50% is already inside the employer IVS rate of the INPS ruleset. Not applied to apprentices, whose overall rate is set by L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773: the engine reports that case provisional. Not checked by a named reviewer.

INPS employer — SIMPLIFICATION: rate 26.93% from kitech.it (non-construction crafts sector 2026, source https://www.kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=1_1; specific INPS circular not retrieved). Component breakdown is part of the KNOWN GAP noted below: the operai-vs-impiegati difference (26.93% vs 24.71% = 2.22pp) does not reconcile with a malattia-only explanation (~0.83pp), suggesting the sector IVS rate may differ from the generic private-sector 23.81%. No CIGO/CIGS for the crafts sector (art. 3 D.Lgs. 148/2015). FSBA (0.45% employer + 0.15% employee) excluded: bilateral fund contribution, not INPS. No size tier.
INPS employee — employee_tiers: 9.19% (IVS + NASpI) flat. No additional CIGS for employees (crafts sector has no CIGS).
fixed_term_additional_rate: NASpI additional rate 1.4% (employer-only) per Art. 2 co. 28 L. 92/2012.

KNOWN GAP: rate_by_category impiegato/quadro = 24.71% confirmed from kitech.it (non-construction crafts sector 2026, employer-only share of 33.90% total; source https://www.kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=1_1). The component breakdown of 24.71% is unknown: it does not reconcile with IVS (23.81%) + NASpI (1.61%) = 25.42%, suggesting either the artigianato IVS employer rate for impiegati is lower than the generic private-sector 23.81% (e.g. 23.10% IVS + 1.61% NASpI = 24.71%), or CUAF and/or NASpI differ in this sector. The operai-to-impiegati gap is 2.22pp (26.93% vs 24.71%), not the ~0.83pp malattia-only difference expected if IVS were uniform. IMPORTANT: the tier-level ivs_rate (23.81%) and the IVS ceiling split for impiegati are therefore also approximate until the component breakdown is confirmed from an authoritative INPS circular.

Apprentice contributions (L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773; L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 36-37): employer 10% + NASpI 1.31% + 0.30% = 11.61%; employee 5.84%. Firms with at most 9 employees pay 1.5% (+1.61% NASpI) in months 0-11 and 3% (+1.61%) in months 12-23, then 11.61%. SIMPLIFICATION: hiring incentives (sgravi) and Cassa Edile apprentice schemes are not modelled.

IVS ceiling: massimale annuo della base contributiva 2026 = EUR 122,295.00 (INPS Circ. 6/2026, 30 Jan 2026; L. 335/1995 art. 2 c. 18). Applies to workers without contributions before 1 Jan 1996 and to those who opted for the contributory system (art. 1 c. 23); the engine derives it from the contribution history.

IVS ceiling and category rates: employer_ivs_rate (23.81%) is a single scalar uniform across all categories in this tier. When ivs_ceiling_applies=True and a category rate override is active (e.g. impiegati 24.71%), the engine assumes the IVS component equals the tier-level ivs_rate (23.81%) and treats the residual (0.90%) as non-IVS. This assumption is unverified for impiegati/quadri; see the KNOWN GAP note above.

Sterilizzazione detrazioni: Art. 1 c. 3-4 L. 199/2025 — for reddito complessivo > EUR 200 000, total detrazioni (Art. 12 + Art. 13 TUIR) reduced by EUR 440 (clawback of the 35% -> 33% bracket benefit on the 28 000-50 000 slice).

Somma esente (L. 207/2024): band cut points 8 500 EUR and 15 000 EUR are reconstructions from worked examples — not verified against primary source. Rates 7.1%/5.3%/4.8% and ceiling 20 000 EUR are from AdE guidance.
